title: When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use the ngx_stream_ssl_module module with dynamic certificate…
description: A vulnerability in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source occurs when using the ngx_stream_ssl_module with dynamic certificate loading combined with the ngx_stream_proxy_module configured with proxy_protocol v2. An abbreviated SSL handshake can cause a worker process to terminate, leading to a denial-of-service (DoS) condition. This issue affects the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. No affected versions or patches are specified, and the vulnerability has a medium severity rating.
